mapper.sql: CASE_ID, CASE_NO, APPLICANT_NAME, BIRTH_DATE, ADDRESS, PHONE, APPLIED_ON, BENEFITS, DEADLINE, EXTEND_REASON, STATUS, ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE_NAME, SURVEY_NOTE, GRANTED_BENEFITS, DECISION_SUMMARY, BENEFIT_METHOD, BENEFIT_START, DECIDED_ON, NOTIFIED_ON, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WELFARE_CASE (CASE_ID, CASE_NO, APPLICANT_NAME, BIRTH_DATE, ADDRESS, PHONE, APPLIED_ON, BENEFITS, DEADLINE, STATUS, ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE_NAME, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{caseNo}, #{applicantName}, #{birthDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{appliedOn, jdbcType=DATE}, #{benefits}, #{deadline, jdbcType=DATE}, 'RECEIVED', #{assigneeId}, #{assigneeName}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE WELFARE_CASE SET SURVEY_NOTE = #{note, jdbcType=CLOB}, STATUS = 'SURVEY' WHERE CASE_ID = #{id} AND STATUS IN ('RECEIVED', 'SURVEY')
UPDATE WELFARE_CASE SET DEADLINE = #{deadline, jdbcType=DATE}, EXTEND_REASON = #{extendReason} WHERE CASE_ID = #{caseId} AND STATUS IN ('RECEIVED', 'SURVEY') AND EXTEND_REASON IS NULL

UPDATE WELFARE_CASE SET STATUS = #{status}, GRANTED_BENEFITS = #{grantedBenefits}, DECISION_SUMMARY = #{decisionSummary}, BENEFIT_METHOD = #{benefitMethod}, BENEFIT_START = #{benefitStart, jdbcType=DATE}, DECIDED_ON = #{decidedOn, jdbcType=DATE}, NOTIFIED_ON = #{notifiedOn, jdbcType=DATE} WHERE CASE_ID = #{caseId} AND STATUS IN ('RECEIVED', 'SURVEY')
UPDATE WELFARE_CASE SET STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN', DECISION_SUMMARY = #{note} WHERE CASE_ID = #{id} AND STATUS IN ('RECEIVED', 'SURVEY')
